name: What are common reasons why a home listing expires?

mainEntity.name: What are common reasons why a home listing expires?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons for an expired listing include an uncompetitive asking price, poor property condition, ineffective marketing, or a lack of agent communication. For example, in competitive markets like Aventura or Boca Raton, overpricing can quickly deter potential buyers, regardless of the property's features. A key preparation step is to work with your agent to conduct a thorough comparative market analysis (CMA) before listing to ensure the price aligns with current market values and similar homes sold in your specific area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Listings often expire due to overpricing, poor property condition, inadequate marketing, or insufficient agent communication.
